description: Implementation of POSIX pthread condition variable functions for Zephyr RTOS, including creation, signaling, broadcasting, waiting, timed waiting, initialization, and destruction of condition variables.

methods.name: pthread_cond_signal
methods.description: Signals one thread waiting on the condition variable.

methods.name: pthread_cond_broadcast
methods.description: Wakes all threads waiting on the condition variable.

methods.name: pthread_cond_wait
methods.description: Waits indefinitely on the condition variable.

methods.name: pthread_cond_timedwait
methods.description: Waits on the condition variable with a timeout.

methods.name: pthread_condattr_getclock
methods.description: Gets the clock used for timedwait.

methods.name: pthread_condattr_setclock
methods.description: Sets the clock used for timedwait.
